Clarification.n3.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law for most states: response window before close. Statutory: MO 90d · TX 61d. Recommend default 30d.

Estimate-Fee.addt.city_config: ⚠ Not-estimable-yet path (prelim search first) — pure city policy on when allowed and its operational target.

Estimate-Fee.drsp.label: Requester response
Estimate-Fee.drsp.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law: requester response window on the estimate. Recommend default 30d.

Estimate-Fee.optout.label: opt-out / no response

production.format_and_medium.summary: An agency may provide a copy of a public record in electronic form if the record is available in electronic form and the person specifically requests an electronic copy.

intake.residency_attestation.summary: The request must include the requester's name, mailing address, email address, telephone number, and a written declaration, attesting or affirming under oath, whether the requester is a resident.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person has the right to examine and take a copy of any public record of the state (no enumerated requester class), subject to statutory exemptions.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: The custodian shall make no inquiry of any person who requests a public record, except to verify identity, to ensure records are not used for prohibited mailing/telephone number lists, or to protect personal information as allowed by law.

Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

acknowledgment.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.initial_decision_window.summary: A public agency or custodian shall either grant or deny a resident's request to examine or copy public records within three (3) working days of receipt of the request.
response.initial_decision_window.clock_spec: fixed: 3 working-days from receipt of request (resident)

response.initial_decision_window.summary: A public agency or custodian shall either grant or deny a request from a person who is not a resident and not employed by a resident to examine or copy public records within twenty-one (21) days of receipt of the request.
response.initial_decision_window.clock_spec: fixed: 21 calendar-days from receipt of request (nonresident)

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: If the public agency or custodian fails to respond within the time allotted for the response, the request shall be deemed to be denied.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: terminal: deemed denial at expiry of the applicable response window (ID-0008/0009, or extension ID-0010/0011)

response.extension_length.summary: If a longer period is needed to locate or retrieve the records, the public agency shall provide the public records no later than ten (10) working days following a resident's request.
response.extension_length.clock_spec: ceiling: no later than 10 working-days from resident's request

response.extension_length.summary: If a longer period is needed to locate or retrieve the records, the public agency shall provide the public records no later than thirty-five (35) days following a nonresident's request.
response.extension_length.clock_spec: ceiling: no later than 35 calendar-days from nonresident's request

completion.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

nonpayment_close.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

special_windows.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

suspension.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

ag_referral.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

denial_deadline.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

fee.labor_charge.summary: Fees for resident requests shall not exceed reasonable labor costs necessarily incurred, charged at the per-hour pay rate of the lowest-paid administrative staff employee or public official of the agency.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: The fee charged to a resident may not exceed the actual cost to the agency of copying the record.
The agency may charge nonresidents higher fees than residents (including for labor and copies without the resident free allotments), but such fees may not exceed the actual cost to the agency.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: For computer records, the agency may charge a fee that does not exceed the sum of the direct cost of copying, the standard cost of publication, and the cost of conversion.

fee.free_allowance.summary: No fee shall be charged for the first two (2) hours of labor in responding to a resident's public records request.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: No fee shall be charged for copying the first one hundred (100) pages of paper records in responding to a resident's request.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: All requests to examine public records shall be made to the designated custodian of such records as defined in section 74-101(3).

payment.advance_payment.summary: The custodian may require advance payment of the fees authorized by this section before providing the records.
